title: A Scenic Journey With My Parents
description: I want to take my parents on a slow train trip across the country, and see the sea with them.
svg_data:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes wave { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-32px); } }
    @keyframes float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  </style>
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none">
    <!-- Far Background -->
    <path d="M50 120 Q 150 80 250 120 T 400 110" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.7"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="60" r="15" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.6"/>
    
    <!-- Midground: Train (Hero) -->
    <g stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8">
      <rect x="120" y="125" width="160" height="40" rx="5"/>
      <path d="M135 125 v-20 h100 v20" />
      <circle cx="145" cy="135" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="185" cy="135" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="225" cy="135" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="265" cy="135" r="8"/>
      <path d="M280 145 l20 0" class="smoke" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite" />
    </g>

    <!-- Foreground: The Sea and Figures -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6">
      <!-- Ground line -->
      <path d="M0 180 h400" />
      <!-- Figures -->
      <path d="M150 180 c5 -20 10 -20 15 0" />
      <circle cx="157" cy="155" r="6" />
      <path d="M170 180 c5 -25 10 -25 15 0" />
      <circle cx="177" cy="150" r="6" />
      <path d="M190 180 c5 -20 10 -20 15 0" />
      <circle cx="197" cy="155" r="6" />
      <!-- Waves -->
      <path d="M0 195 q20 -10 40 0 t40 0 t40 0 t40 0 t40 0 t40 0 t40 0 t40 0" stroke-dasharray="14 8" style="animation: wave 5s linear infinite" />
    </g>

    <!-- Texture -->
    <g stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" opacity="0.6">
      <path d="M125 165 h10 m10 0 h10 m10 0 h10" />
      <path d="M30 185 l5 5 M40 185 l5 5 M350 185 l5 5" />
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>

title: Launch a Product People Love
description: Build and launch my own small product — something a few people truly rely on.
svg_data:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes wave { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-32px); } }
    @keyframes float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  </style>
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Defining Prop: A miniature desktop workspace (The "Product" being built) -->
    <!-- Hero: A small, sturdy wooden workbench with a laptop open -->
    <path d="M140 160h120v-50h-120z" stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M160 110v-30h80v30" stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M150 80h100v-5h-100z" stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Defining Prop: A small "User" icon (The person relying on it) -->
    <path d="M280 150c-5-20 5-30 10-30s15 10 10 30" stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/>
    <circle cx="295" cy="115" r="6" stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Ground Line -->
    <path d="M50 160h300" stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Background: Distant hills -->
    <path d="M50 160c40-40 80-20 120-30s80-20 150-10" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none"/>
    <path d="M30 160c50-60 100-30 150-40s100-20 200-5" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Motion Element 1: Floating "Idea" sparks -->
    <g style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite">
        <circle cx="200" cy="60" r="2" fill="#2E2B33"/>
        <circle cx="210" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#2E2B33"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- Motion Element 2: A soft breeze/cloud line -->
    <path d="M320 70c-20-10-40 0-60-10" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite"/>
    
    <!-- Texture: Ground ticks -->
    <path d="M60 162v5 M100 162v3 M340 162v4" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Shadow -->
    <path d="M145 165h110" stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 4" fill="none"/>
  </g>
</svg>

title: Reclaiming My Body Through Swimming
description: Get back to swimming twice a week and feel at home in my body again.
svg_data:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    @keyframes wave { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-32px); } }
    @keyframes float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-9px); } }
  </style>
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Horizon Line -->
    <path d="M40 160 Q 200 150 360 160" fill="none" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" />
    
    <!-- Distant hills -->
    <path d="M30 160 Q 100 130 150 150 M250 150 Q 300 120 370 150" fill="none" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" />

    <!-- Hero: The Swimmer (Gesture Figure) -->
    <g stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="2.6">
      <path d="M180 120 Q 200 110 220 120 Q 230 140 220 150" fill="none" />
      <circle cx="215" cy="115" r="5" fill="none" />
      <path d="M190 130 L170 145" fill="none" />
      <path d="M210 135 L230 155" fill="none" />
    </g>

    <!-- Defining Prop: Goggles on forehead -->
    <path d="M210 112 Q 215 110 220 112" fill="none" stroke="#2E2B33" stroke-width="1.8" />

    <!-- Water Layers -->
    <g stroke="#6B5C8E" stroke-width="1.8" style="animation: wave 5s linear infinite">
      <path d="M0 170 Q 50 160 100 170 T 200 170 T 300 170 T 400 170" fill="none" stroke-dasharray="14 8" />
      <path d="M0 185 Q 50 175 100 185 T 200 185 T 300 185 T 400 185" fill="none" stroke-dasharray="14 8" />
    </g>

    <!-- Foreground details -->
    <path d="M80 180 L85 175 M85 180 L90 175" fill="none" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" />
    <path d="M320 185 L325 180 M325 185 L330 180" fill="none" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" />

    <!-- Texture -->
    <path d="M190 155 L200 155 M205 155 L215 155" fill="none" stroke="#B5A8D0" stroke-width="1.3" />

    <!-- Floating element: Sun/Star -->
    <circle cx="340" cy="60" r="3" fill="#B5A8D0" style="animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite" />
  </g>
</svg>
